identification: Still life oil, white Tasmanian Christmas bush (Bursaria) blossom in a cut-glass vase on a brown table against a brown ground, on board, in a gilt-edged cream slip and pale gold timber frame, about 24 x 29 cm. Catalogued as Nell Frankcombe (Tasmanian, 1906-2001), whose subject matter (Tasmanian native flora, berries, small oils on board) fits. No signature visible in the photo; there is a faint pencil-like mark on the white slip below the centre that cannot be read. Estimate A$60-120, current bid A$50.

viewing_check: Look hard at the lower edge under the slip and on the back for a signature, 'N. Frankcombe' label or title inscription; read the faint mark on the slip lower centre. Signed vs unsigned is the whole value difference, and even signed it does not make A$200 profit.
